decisions.reason: The marine box cooler system fits the core marine heat-exchange business and its earlier strong market-share signal makes continued support the most likely choice.
The marine cooling unit remains a logical extension of the firm's marine offering, though the lack of later visible evidence warrants some caution.
The compact oil cooler still complements the firm's industrial portfolio, but as a less differentiated newer line it faces a somewhat higher rationalization risk.
Finned tubes for air coolers support both equipment supply and aftermarket service, so they remain strategically useful despite being a more component-oriented product.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes match the firm's R&D-driven efficiency focus and are therefore likely to be retained unless portfolio simplification becomes necessary.
